Author: Tiraesias; Enhanced fork: pascalial98-hue
Name: POV+ Enhanced
Description:
看见自己的身体，自由观察、探头，并用引导校准到适合自己的视点。支持头部隐藏、可选完整头影、鼠标直控和中英界面。面向国服 / Dalamud API 15，国际服尚未验证。
See your body, look around and lean naturally, with guided viewpoint calibration. Includes head hiding, optional full head shadows, direct mouse look and bilingual settings. Targets FFXIV CN / Dalamud API 15; international clients are unverified.
Punchline: 沉浸式第一人称增强 / Enhanced first-person camera (CN)
